title: The Heartbeat
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter I, Episode 6: The Heartbeat. The notes were home, but the world was still silent — a note with no time is only a sound. The Keeper travels the turning world for its heartbeat, finds it beating in the winter, and brings it home; the notes begin to sing in time, and the silent world becomes a song.  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #storytelling
